comment.text:
Bomb look
Pick what the aliens drop.

Laser look
Want to shoot stars or hearts instead? Pick a costume for the laser here.

Cannon look
Pick any costume for the cannon: a rocket, a cat, a robot. The game reads it from here, so this is the only place to change it.

Damage
Lives a bomb takes away. Try 2 for a hard game, or 0 and nothing can hurt you.

Points for an alien
What each alien you hit is worth.

Most bombs at once
Only this many bombs can fall at the same time.

Bomb chance
Each step, every alien has 1 chance in this many to drop a bomb. A smaller number makes a bomb storm.

Bomb speed
How fast bombs fall. Try 10 for fast bombs.

Alien drop
How far the aliens come down when they reach the edge.

Alien march step
How far the aliens step sideways each time. Bigger is faster and scarier.

Aliens in a row
Each of the three rows has this many aliens. Up to 10 fit across the sky.

Laser speed and direction
How far the laser flies up each step. Try 20 for a super laser. A minus number would shoot it down!

Cannon speed
How fast the arrow keys slide the cannon. Try 400 for a zippy cannon.

Lives at the start
How many bombs can hit you before the game is over. Try 5 for an easier game, or 1 if you are brave.

Settings
The numbers and looks that make this game what it is. Every script reads them from here, so one change is all it takes. Programmers call a place like this a config.

Alien march timing
The wait between steps: 0.1 seconds, plus 0.025 for every alien still flying. Fewer aliens means a faster march!
